summary: Bento grid of 4 or 5 service cards; the first card is large with a check list. On hover a card with a link rises 3px and its border turns the brand colour. Optional "photo" on the first card: a real photo of the work (team at desks, a support floor, paperwork) fills the top of the large card above its title, text and check list, and the icon is dropped there; the photo zooms slightly on hover when the card has a link. A photo on any other card is ignored.
